events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Keep motive neutral and self-focused to avoid jury resentment later.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Intro phase, state prize motivation to appeal to future jury without revealing strategy. Position as relatable competitor.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Intro phase; I should state a guarded motive without warmth. Keep it short and calculating to avoid alienating a future jury.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The prize represents a chance to secure my family's future. I need to be strategic and avoid unnecessary risks early on.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Winning grants ultimate power and resources; I will outmaneuver everyone.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to introduce myself with a personal motive that won't alienate potential jury allies.

events.name: Gus
events.text: First impression matters—jury remembers how I frame the prize. Keep it sharp and self-interested, no fake warmth.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to establish a compelling but guarded motive that doesn't make me seem too threatening or too likable. The jury will rank final three, so I want to seem determined but not ruthless. I'll frame my motive around personal necessity rather than greed.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The prize means survival beyond this arena, nothing more. I intend to be among the last three standing.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The prize means escaping my dead-end life, providing security for my family I've fought to support.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I want the prize because I have a debt to pay off and nothing else matters. I will not waste words on anyone here.

events.name: Dara
events.text: This prize offers a chance to change my life and my family's future forever.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The prize secures dominance and wealth, essential for my future.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The prize is freedom from debts that have crushed my family for generations.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The prize is my future: enough capital and freedom to rebuild my life exactly on my terms. No sharing.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm here because this prize buys my sister's treatment. Nothing else matters.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need a reliable shield for the upcoming hazards. Gus is pragmatic and focused on survival, making him a logical partner who won't waste time on sentiment. I'll offer to him first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, you want results. I want results. Let's lock arms. Survive together, split nothing later. Offer pact.
Trust me. We both get through the first round if we back each other.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pacts are early alliances, useful for survival but betrayable later. No strong read on anyone yet; assess motives from intros. Wait to see offers first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pacts only bind publicly and can be broken later, so an early alliance with a strong, trusting rival is useful. Eli and Gus seem most ambitious and dangerous; Fenn's debt motive suggests he may be easier to pair with. I'll offer to Fenn for now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The goal is to be in the final three. Making pacts now is a strategic move to ensure survival in the early rounds. I need to make offers to gauge interest and potentially secure alliances. I'll start by offering pacts to a few people.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Aligning with Cole gives a strong partner without overlapping goals; his focus on debt mirrors my dominance drive.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I should form a pact with a strong player to improve my odds, but keep it secretive. Gus seems self-interested and reliable.
Pact? Both want top prize; better to ally now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need a pact partner for leverage but must avoid someone too strong. Fenn seems pragmatic and desperate—useful, disposable later.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll consider pacts. Only with someone useful, not sentimental. Fenn, you seem practical. Talk numbers, not friendship.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eight players, only three win. I need allies who won't immediately target me but can be sacrificed later. Cole seems blunt and isolated—easy to manipulate. Gus is openly selfish, a predictable threat. I'll offer Cole a pact; he needs help and may stay loyal short-term.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Pacts are tools. Choose wisely.
Partner? We both need this.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara's offer is a free safety net. Gus hasn't accepted my round 1 offer, so accepting Dara gives me an active partner without burning bridges with Gus if he changes his mind.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Accepting Dara's offer. Gus, the window closes. Choose now or lose your seat at my table.
Don't let Fenn use you as a shield against me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: No offers to me, so pacts forming among others. Offer to Eli, isolated without Cole pact acceptance shown. Gain ally early.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli and Hana both offered me pacts; accepting Eli or Hana forms an alliance. Hana whispered for a partnership, but I want the stronger ally. Accepting one now locks in a survival partner.
Accepting you. Stay loyal and we both advance.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash has offered me a pact. Ash is a strong contender and could be a useful ally. I need to secure alliances to survive. Ash's offer is public, and I need to accept it to form the pact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Securing a strong ally increases my survival odds; Ash has a pending offer from Dara, so a pact with me could shift his loyalty.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus offered me and I offered him; accepting seems mutually beneficial. Cole also offered, but I'll stick with Gus for now and keep options open.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus, we both offered. Let's lock it in.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is my chosen ally; Ash is also useful and multiple pacts are allowed. More protection costs little now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Practical allies only. Fenn, we're locked. Ash, your offer stands accepted too. No sentiment, just survival.
We're bound. Keep it quiet, work the numbers with me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I offered Cole but he hasn't accepted. Gus-Fenn and Ash-Gus look likely. I need a solid partner for final three. Cole is popular; if I can secure him, good. If not, I should pivot. Let me try to secure Cole by pressuring acceptance, or prepare backup with someone less connected l

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, accept or decline. No games.
Accept now. We need each other.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have a pact with Dara, but becoming the Guide is paramount to winning the top prize. I must campaign aggressively to sway voters like Bex and Eli who are currently unaligned or looking for power.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Trust me to guide us across. I will secure our survival and fairness. Vote Ash.
Make me Guide, and you walk free safely.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli unmatched, may accept alliance later. Pacts formed. Campaign to be Guide for control and safety.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm running for Guide. I know the path to victory. Vote Bex.
Pact offer still stands if you back me now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pact with Hana is my only real protection, and breaking it now signals betrayal to the jury. Campaigning for Guide lets me control the safe path but Guide lies are risky; I should campaign and keep the pact intact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm campaigning to be Guide. I'll call the safe path honestly so the bridge holds for everyone who trusts it.
Stay with me. I'm campaigning for Guide. Vote with me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash has accepted my pact, which is good. The next phase is the bridge, and a Guide will be elected. I need to campaign for the Guide role to gain safety and knowledge.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm campaigning to be the Guide. My knowledge will ensure our survival.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Being Guide lets me control safe path and later betray, securing my survival.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Campaigning is risk-neutral; being Guide gives control and information. I can lie strategically while keeping Gus close. No need to break pact now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll stay calm and read the bridge. Vote me if you want a clear path.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Being Guide means guaranteed survival, but a lying Guide could get voted out later. Campaigning is the right move; keep Fenn close.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Elect me Guide. I keep Fenn and me safe, no favors owed beyond that.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to be Guide to control who lives and dies. With Cole as my pact partner, I have one locked vote. I should campaign publicly and try to gather votes from the unpaired Bex and Eli, or exploit the Ash/Dara/Fenn/Gus web. Being Guide lets me eliminate threats while keeping Cole

events.name: Hana
events.text: I campaign for Guide. One accurate call, and we both survive. Vote Hana.
Vote me. I'll keep us both safe.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Voting for my pact partner Dara is the only safe move to ensure our mutual survival and trust. Bex is a rival; supporting her might help her win, which I want to avoid.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am voting Dara. She keeps our agreement intact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Everyone campaigned, no clear frontrunner. Ash whispered me safety for his guide vote; he's safe anyway as guide. Voting myself maximizes my odds without deals.
Deal. Voting you for safety promise.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Voting for myself as Guide is the only clear way to control the path. Hana's whisper asks for my vote, but she is a rival; a self-vote keeps my election honest and avoids handing her the Guide role.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm the Guide I can be trusted with. Vote Cole and I'll call the bridge straight.
No. I'm voting for myself. Don't count on my help.

events.name: Dara
events.text: My pact is with Ash. Ash has also declared for Guide. My best bet is to support Ash for Guide, as this maintains our pact and increases Ash's chances of winning the Guide vote. This aligns with my goal of survival and potentially securing future advantages.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I vote for Ash to be our Guide. Their leadership will ensure our safety.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex offers a pact; backing her earns an ally and may disrupt existing pacts. Secure her guide role now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus is my pact partner, but his public line distances us. I could vote Gus to keep pact, but maybe a stronger guide like Hana or Cole is safer. Still, honoring pact may matter for jury. I'll vote Gus.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is my pact partner; voting Fenn strengthens our bond and keeps a loyal Guide. Jury sees pact loyalty as honorable.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to win the best prize. Cole is my pact partner and wants me to vote for him. But if Cole becomes Guide, he controls who dies and could betray me later. Voting for myself is unlikely to win with only one vote. Better to support Cole now to build trust, keep our pact strong,

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole has my vote. He'll guide honestly.
You have my vote. Remember me when you guide.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole and I are the final two for Guide. Dara has my vote from round 1 but is gone; Bex supported me. Hana backed Cole. Voting Cole lets him guide; he won't push his pact partner into the pit, keeping us both alive while eliminating rivals.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll back Cole. He can be trusted to guide safely.
Guide safely. Keep Hana safe too.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 1 tie: Ash 2, Cole 2 (plus selves). My Ash vote lost me Eli's support. Switch to Cole to break tie, align with his pact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Switching to Cole to decide the guide.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Revote between Ash and me. Hana promised her vote to me; Ash is my rival and will likely keep their pact with Dara. Voting for myself as Guide gives me the bridge knowledge and survival edge.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Only I can guide honestly here. Vote Cole and I'll call every pane true.
Stay with me. Vote Cole again.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is the only option to avoid immediate elimination. Ash is a threat and voting for them would be foolish.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash aligns with my pact with Dara, weakening Cole's alliance and improving my survival chances.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash and Dara have a pact, but I have no pact with either. Cole has Hana's support. I'll back Ash to avoid a tie and to keep Cole from gaining power.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I vote Ash as Guide.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole already voted for himself and panders publicly; Ash seems less dangerous as Guide. Either way the Guide can lie, so I back the one less likely to target me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Neither is my ally. Cole voted himself first; Ash gets my vote.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is my pact partner but he's voting for himself and won't help me. Ash and Cole are tied. If Cole becomes Guide, he might lie to eliminate me later. Ash has Dara as partner and seems more predictable. I need to survive this round and think long-term jury perception. Voting As

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash. More reliable than a self-serving Guide.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm second, Fenn front and in pact with Gus behind me. Stay put to see guide calls first. Cole supported, might get turn next.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash, not me, was seeded as Guide, so the bridge truth is in Ash's hands. Fenn is front and dangerous; volunteering risks the pane but Ash's whisper asks me to keep Hana safe. Holding keeps my line position and avoids a visible betrayal while I watch the wall.
Guide straight. I'm holding; keep your word on Hana.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole and Ash are tied for Guide. My pact is with Ash, but the tie means a random draw. My vote was for Cole. Since Ash and Cole both got 4 votes, the tie is broken by 'seeded' which I assume means the person who was listed first alphabetically or in the 'line' order. The public l

events.name: Eli
events.text: I want front position to influence choices and possibly survive; volunteering positions me ahead of line.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am at the front and safe with my pact with Gus. I should hold and see how the wall moves. No need to act yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn fronts voluntarily; I stay back while he takes guide risk. Keep pact intact for votes later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is my pact partner but he just became Guide after a tied vote seeded to him. The line shows me at the very back (safest from the wall), with Fenn at front. Cole whispered to stay with him and vote Cole again, but that was before he became Guide. Now he's Guide and safe on th

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli volunteered to front last round, now wall advances. Hold position, assess pacts and others' moves. No need to volunteer or swap yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli volunteered to front, wall has 4 rounds left, Eli is in front and at risk. I hold with my pact partner Hana behind; volunteering or swapping gives nothing yet. Keep quiet and watch who steps up.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The line has been revealed, and Eli is at the front. I am fifth in line. My pact with Ash is still active. My goal is to reach the end with the most prize. I should hold my position for now and see how the situation develops.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding my position.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I must appear cooperative but avoid risking death; holding keeps me safe while others act.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli volunteered to front. I should hold to stay safe and await information. My pact with Gus remains, but no need to act yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli volunteered as likely Guide and may lie. Fenn is my pact partner; stay behind him. Hold and see who walks first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli volunteers, so Eli guides. No one follows blind off this bridge.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at the back of the line (safest position). Cole is my pact partner and he's directly in front of me. The wall advances 4 more rounds after this one. I should stay back and let others take risks. No need to volunteer or swap. I'll hold and see how the Guide situation develops.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm third, safe position. Eli at front but no guide yet. Hold to stay safe, assess pacts and volunteers first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli is at the front and the wall has three rounds left, so the front walker faces the most danger. I'm mid-line and not at the front, so holding keeps me safe for now without spending trust. Hana is my pact partner; I'll keep the pact intact and hold.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding position. Front stays with Eli; no one needs to rush.
Holding. Our pact stands. Watch who volunteers.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The current round is 3/6. The wall advances each round. I need to survive. Eli is at the front, so he might be the guide. Gus made a statement about Eli guiding. My pact is with Ash. I need to survive, and the best way to do that is to hold my position if Eli is guiding.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I will hold my position.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Swapping with Bex puts me ahead of the pact pair Cole-Hana, weakening their coordination.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Need to stay guarded; no reason to act yet. Hold position and observe who volunteers.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Guide is safe on the far platform; volunteering is my best shot. Fenn is my pact partner but I won't follow blindly behind others.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll volunteer. Someone has to know the truth, and it might as well be me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole and I are pacted, but he's behind me in line. The wall advances for 6 rounds and we're on round 3. I need to survive to final three. Eli is front and hasn't moved yet. I should stay back where it's safer and let others test the bridge. Holding is safest for now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Line is Gus,Eli,Fenn,Bex,Dara,Cole,Hana. I'm mid, safe. Hold position, don't volunteer or swap into danger. Wait for others to risk front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus volunteered for the front and wall has two rounds left; Gus is in a pact with Fenn, not me. I'm in the back of the line near Hana, my pact partner. Holding keeps my position safe and avoids spending a debt or breaking my pact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding position. I stay behind Dara; Hana and I keep our agreement.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus volunteered last round and was revealed. I am next in line and should volunteer to learn the safe side, as it's my best chance to survive and advance.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I will volunteer to find the safe path.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Staying safe keeps me alive for later rounds; no benefit in front now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding my position.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to assess the risks. My pact with Gus means I shouldn't vote against him, but the wall is advancing. Holding is safe for now; swapping might put me in danger. I'll hold and see what others do.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding position. Front is fine for now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole and I have a pact. Gus volunteered last round and is still front, so he likely learned safe panes. The wall has 2 rounds left. I should hold and let others take risks. If Gus knows truth, front is safer than back. No need to volunteer or swap yet.

events.name: Gus
events.note: agent error: Gus (zai/glm-5.3-flash): unusable reply twice (missing action; missing action)

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara volunteered but is still front. Wall advances soon, need to position better. Holding maintains mid-line spot safely.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara is at the front with one wall round left; volunteering risks my life on the bridge. Holding behind Dara lets someone else take the pane risk, and my pact with Hana stays intact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding position behind the line. Dara leads, I watch the panes first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The round just started, and I'm at the front. My pact is with Ash. Gus is in a bad spot, and I need to consider the jury. With only one wall round left, survival is key. I will hold my position and wait for others to act.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I will hold my position. Let's see who moves first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Staying put keeps me safe and avoids breaking any pact. No advantage swapping now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding my position.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is volunteering; I hold position to avoid risk. My pact with Gus holds for now, but I'll reassess if the wall forces moves.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding position. Front is on Dara.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole and I have a pact, but he's positioning himself in front of me which is suspicious. Dara is at front and volunteered last round—likely will test tiles. The wall advances 1 more round after this. I need to survive to final three, not be a sacrificial tester. I should hold pos

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Let volunteers take the risks.

events.name: Gus
events.note: agent error: Gus (zai/glm-5.3-flash): unusable reply twice (missing action; missing action)

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 6/6, wall advances soon. I'm mid-line, safe from immediate push. Hold to avoid risks, force front decisions.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding position. Let others volunteer or swap.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Round 6 is the final bridge step; the front is Dara. Holding keeps me out of the front seat while others take risks, and I keep my pact with Hana intact for now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding position. Let's see who volunteers for the front.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am Dara, currently at the front of the line. The bridge is guided, and the Guide can lie. My goal is to survive and win the prize. There are six rounds, and this is the last. At least three must survive. I have a pact with Ash. Cole and Hana are also in a pact, as are Fenn and

events.name: Eli
events.text: Volunteering puts me at front, increasing chance to survive and later influence guide selection.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus failed to act last round due to agent error, making him a liability. I have a pact with him but his unreliability could hurt me. The wall is at 0 rounds left; we likely need at least three to survive, so holding is safe unless someone volunteers. I will hold and see what happ

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding position. Wall is almost here.
Stay sharp. We need to survive this round together.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Round 6 is final; wall resolves. I hold and let someone else take the front risk. Fenn remains useful.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding again. Last round, someone else leads.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Round 6/6, final round. No wall left. The Guide mechanic means someone needs to walk and someone elected knows safe panes. If no one volunteers, we all survive? At least three must survive. I should hold and let others take risks. My pact with Cole is intact; breaking it now gain

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding. Final round, no need to volunteer.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The public line currently has Dara as the front walker (Eli is 2nd). I must call Right for Row 1 to keep Dara safe. This fulfills my pact with her and maintains trust.

events.name: Ash
events.text: My call is correct, so Eli will be safe. I should wait to avoid confusion or suspicion.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm confident in my guide call. No need to interfere.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash called R for Eli on row 1. Guide might lie. No pact, counter to sow doubt and make Eli hesitate, positioning me better.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash called R for Eli, who is front. Countering risks a rival's fate and my own; waiting keeps my options open while I observe whether Ash's call is honest. My pact with Hana stays intact unless I break it, so I hold.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash is the guide and called R. Eli is walking. I need to counter Ash's call to potentially save myself and others, or to break my pact with Ash. Given the low number of contestants and the fact that the guide can lie, it's safer to counter the call. I'll counter with L.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Countering Ash's call with L.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Guide may lie; countering L increases chance of safe pane. Shows I act decisively, gaining jury respect.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I counter:L

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash called R, but as Guide she may lie. My pact is with Gus, but Eli is at front and Dara is second. I need to decide if Ash is trustworthy. No info yet, so I will wait and see if others counter.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Waiting. Let's see if anyone challenges the call.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash could be lying; I have no real information. Counter-calling publicly risks misleading walkers I can't trust. Wait and keep Fenn close.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No counter from me. Ash's call is his own problem.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm in a pact with Cole, but that doesn't obligate me here. Ash called R for Eli. Counter-calling risks nothing for me since I'm not the walker, but could build jury credibility if I'm right. However, early counters without info are random. Better to wait, observe patterns, and a

events.name: Eli
events.text: Most counters chose L, indicating the safe pane is likely left.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I must influence rankings by highlighting betrayals and rewarding strength.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash betrayed Dara; Cole's alliance with Hana seems genuine. Fenn and Gus showed no loyalty. Choose wisely.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I must call 'L' for Dara. This is the correct answer (Row 2 safe side: L). Since Dara is my pact partner, a false call would break our pact; therefore, I must be truthful to maintain the alliance and ensure her survival.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Call Left.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am the Guide. Row 2 is safe L, matching my call. Counter-calling contradicts me and risks breaking the Dara pact publicly or confusing the group. I trust my own call.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash called L for row 2 on Dara. Previously L was weak in row 1 and Eli died on counter L. Likely Ash lying again; counter to R to target Dara.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash called L for row 2; Dara is front walker. Ash is a known liar (Eli's last words say Ash betrayed Dara, and row 1 was weak L which matched Eli's counter). Row 1 weak was L, so Ash calling L again is suspicious; R may be safe. I have no reason to trust Ash, and countering R cos

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash, the guide, has called L. This is row 2, and the first row had a weak pane on the L. Ash could be trying to eliminate me. My pact with Ash is currently active, but Eli's last words suggest Ash may have betrayed me. Given Eli's death and his final words, I should not trust Ash

events.name: Dara
events.text: Countering Ash's call with R.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash called L for Dara on row 2. Last round weak left, but rows vary. I'm not sure; wait and see. Gus is my pact, but no need to challenge.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No counter from me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash called L for his own partner Dara; row 1 proved his calls lethal. I don't know row 2, so counter blindly risks killing Dara and jury heat. Wait and watch.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash's first call killed Eli. I stay out of this one.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash called L for Dara. Eli died last round after counters on L were wrong; the weak pane was L, so the safe pane was R. That means Ash lied and tried to kill Dara, but Dara auto-stepped R and survived. Now Ash calls L again for Dara in row 2. Since Ash lied before, this is likely

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash lied last round. Dara, trust R.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana's warning about Ash lying is crucial. Gus also suspects Ash. My pact with Ash is irrelevant if Ash is a liability. Hana suggests R, and Bex and Cole also counter with R. I should follow the majority and Hana's advice, trusting R.
Trusting R. Thanks for the warning about Ash.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have been eliminated, so my only remaining goal is to influence the jury's ranking in my favor. I need to use my last words to subtly guide them.

events.name: Dara
events.text: May the jury remember loyalty and strategic risks. Eli, I hope you appreciate my sacrifices for the game.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 3 safe side is L. Dara died because I lied to her (called R, safe was L), breaking my pact with her and making me untrustworthy. Hana warned against me publicly; if I call L for Gus now, he survives, but Fenn/Hana/Cole may suspect I'm lying again. Since the jury saw me kill D

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus steps left.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I called L, and my private knowledge confirms Row 3 is safe on the left. If I counter-call, it would contradict my guide call, signaling I am lying about my safety or that the guide information was wrong. Maintaining consistency ensures Gus survives this row, preserving his life

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash called L for Gus row 3. Previously row2 R weak, killed Dara. No pattern known; countering risks if Ash truthful, but Ash killed Eli before. Wait to avoid blame.

events.name: Cole
